sm.$description: Micro-interactions like focus rings and state changes

md.$description: Standard transitions like menus and popovers

lg.$description: Deliberate animations like slides and reveals

xl.$description: Extended animations like complex or multi-step transitions

gentle.$description: Subtle easing for hover, color, and background transitions

standard.$description: Balanced easing for on-screen movement like resizing, morphing, and layout shifts

decelerate.$description: Decelerating easing for elements entering or exiting the screen, such as menus and popovers

decelerate-emphasized.$description: Expressive easing for prominent elements entering or exiting, like dialogs and drawers
